label: Lyapunov Relational Stability Certificate Episode

s0_initial_problem.problem_statement: General autonomous state-space differential system dot(x_k) = X_k(t, x_1, ..., x_n) with equilibrium at origin.

q_deficiency.why_direct_solution_fails: Cannot integrate nonlinear trajectories in closed form; local power series expansions conceal global asymptotic convergence and may diverge outside small radii.

a_admissibility.permissible_domain: Local neighborhood U subset R^n containing origin; small perturbation regime.
a_admissibility.admissibility_class: Continuously differentiable vector fields X_k with X_k(t, 0) = 0.

x_auxiliary_construction.space_change: Phase space R^n -> 1D scalar energy-like certificate field R

invariants: Negative semi-definiteness of orbital derivative dot(V) <= 0

t_transformation_decision.decision_description: Evaluate directional Lie derivative of scalar field along system trajectories without solving for x(t).

s1_resulting_conclusion.conclusion_statement: Asymptotic stability or Lyapunov stability certified for all trajectories originating in U without explicit integration.

what_need_not_be_computed: Exact closed-form solution of nonlinear differential equations
excluded_alternatives: Local Taylor series expansions around single points
Direct numerical integration over infinite time horizons

notes: Core methodological innovation: do not solve x(t); construct auxiliary V(x) and test orbital action to certify stability of trajectories never explicitly calculated.

label: Tikhonov Problem Reformulation & Smoothing Functional Episode

s0_initial_problem.problem_statement: First-kind Fredholm integral equation A[x, z(s)] = int K(x,s) z(s) ds = u_bar(x) with noisy data u_bar.

q_deficiency.why_direct_solution_fails: Inverse operator A^{-1} is unbounded; arbitrary small noise delta in data causes catastrophic unbounded oscillation in reconstructed z(s).

a_admissibility.permissible_domain: Compact or coercive subset of Sobolev space W_2^1[a,b] with square-integrable derivatives.
a_admissibility.admissibility_class: Smooth functions with bounded derivative energy int (k(z')^2 + p z^2) ds < infinity.

x_auxiliary_construction.auxiliary_object_name: Tikhonov Smoothing Functional M^alpha[z, u_bar] and Penalty Omega[z]
x_auxiliary_construction.space_change: Unbounded inverse in L_2 -> Coercive strictly convex variational problem in W_2^1

t_transformation_decision.decision_description: Replace ill-posed exact inversion with unconstrained minimization of smoothing functional M^alpha = N + alpha Omega.
t_transformation_decision.computation_on_auxiliary: z_alpha = argmin_z (||Az - u_bar||_2^2 + alpha int (k(s)(z')^2 + p(s)z^2) ds)

s1_resulting_conclusion.conclusion_statement: Unique, stable regularized solution z_alpha converges strongly to exact solution as noise level delta -> 0 with matched alpha(delta).

what_need_not_be_computed: Pointwise noise inversion without smoothness regularization
excluded_alternatives: Direct matrix inversion of discretized ill-conditioned Fredholm kernel

notes: Core methodological innovation: when the desired operation is unstable, do not demand exact inversion; redefine the admissible solution class and solve a modified stable variational problem.

label: Pontryagin Dual Costate & Hamiltonian Extremum Episode

s0_initial_problem.problem_statement: Controlled phase-space dynamical system dot(x^i) = f^i(x, u) with integral objective functional J = int f^0(x, u) dt and bounded control set U.
s0_initial_problem.state_space: Tangent bundle TM over state manifold R^n

q_deficiency.why_direct_solution_fails: Control region U is a closed, bounded subset (not open), rendering classical Euler-Lagrange stationarity dL/du = 0 invalid on the control boundary.

a_admissibility.permissible_domain: Piecewise continuous bounded measurable controls u(t) in U.
a_admissibility.admissibility_class: Class D of admissible controls transferring initial state x_0 to target state x_1.

x_auxiliary_construction.auxiliary_object_name: Adjoint Costate Vector psi(t) and Control Hamiltonian H(psi, x, u)
x_auxiliary_construction.auxiliary_representation_space: Cotangent phase bundle T*M with symplectic structure
x_auxiliary_construction.space_change: State manifold R^n -> Symplectic phase space R^n x R^n (state x and shadow costate psi)

invariants: Linearity of Hamiltonian in costate psi
Maximum dominance H(psi, x, u*) >= H(psi, x, u)
c_constraints_invariants.admissibility_bounds: u in U; Mayer normalization psi_0 = 0 in time-optimal case

t_transformation_decision.decision_description: Convert global trajectory variation into instantaneous pointwise maximization of bilinear Hamiltonian along canonical state-adjoint flow.
t_transformation_decision.computation_on_auxiliary: dot(x) = dH/dpsi, dot(psi) = -dH/dx, u*(t) = argmax_{u in U} H(psi(t), x(t), u)

s1_resulting_conclusion.conclusion_statement: Exact necessary conditions for optimal trajectory determined globally, including bang-bang controls on boundary of U.

what_need_not_be_computed: Global functional variations over infinite-dimensional path spaces
Higher-order second variations delta^2 J on interior domains
excluded_alternatives: Dynamic programming PDE everywhere in phase space (Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman everywhere)

notes: Core methodological innovation: introduce dual auxiliary costate psi(t) measuring future sensitivity; replace global path minimization with pointwise Hamiltonian maximization.

label: Gelfand-Levitan Auxiliary Kernel Inverse Scattering Episode

s0_initial_problem.problem_statement: Inverse spectral problem: reconstruct potential q(x) in -y'' + q(x)y = lambda y from spectral measure dtau(lambda).

q_deficiency.why_direct_solution_fails: Direct mapping from spectral data dtau to differential operator coefficient q(x) is nonlinear, nonlocal, and ill-conditioned.

a_admissibility.permissible_domain: Spectral measure dtau with proper asymptotic behavior relative to unperturbed base operator q_0 = 0.
a_admissibility.admissibility_class: Locally integrable potentials q in L_1^{loc}[0, infinity).

x_auxiliary_construction.auxiliary_object_name: Triangular Transformation Kernel K(x,y) and Spectral Kernel f(x,y)
x_auxiliary_construction.auxiliary_representation_space: Triangular domain L_2(Delta) with Delta = {(x,y) : 0 <= y <= x}
x_auxiliary_construction.space_change: 1D Spectral measure dtau -> 2D causal triangular kernel field K(x,y)

invariants: Linearity of integral equation in unknown kernel K
Zero spectral perturbation yields zero kernel (zero potential)
c_constraints_invariants.admissibility_bounds: K(x,y) = 0 for y > x (causal triangular support)

t_transformation_decision.decision_description: Convert nonlinear inverse spectral problem into linear Fredholm integral equation for transformation kernel K(x,y), followed by diagonal differentiation.

s1_resulting_conclusion.conclusion_statement: Unique, constructive recovery of potential q(x) achieved by solving linear integral equation.

what_need_not_be_computed: Simultaneous determination of potential everywhere without causal triangular marching
excluded_alternatives: Direct nonlinear root finding on eigenvalue distributions
Nonlinear inverse optimization in function space

notes: Core methodological innovation: do not invert spectral measure directly to potential; construct auxiliary 2D triangular kernel K(x,y), solve a linear integral equation, and recover potential on the diagonal.

label: Vlasov Kinetic Distribution & Self-Consistent Collective Closure Episode

s0_initial_problem.problem_statement: N-body charged particle ensemble with pairwise Coulomb interactions and rapid divergence of individual particle trajectories.

q_deficiency.why_direct_solution_fails: N-body Coulomb Hamiltonian cannot be solved for N >> 1; binary collision approaches (Boltzmann/Landau) fail to capture collective long-range plasma oscillations because Coulomb cross-section diverges at small angles.

a_admissibility.permissible_domain: Dense plasma regime where Debye sphere contains many particles (N_D >> 1).
a_admissibility.admissibility_class: Collisionless limit C_i[f] -> 0; smooth 6D phase space distribution.

x_auxiliary_construction.auxiliary_object_name: Kinetic Distribution Function f_i(r, v, t) and Self-Consistent Collective Field (E, H)
x_auxiliary_construction.auxiliary_representation_space: Continuous 6D Phase Space R^3 x R^3 coupled to Maxwell Field Bundle
x_auxiliary_construction.space_change: Discrete 6N particle coordinates -> Continuous single-particle distribution manifold f_i(r, v, t)

invariants: Self-consistent loop closure between distribution velocity moments and Maxwell fields
Frequency charge sign independence omega_0^2 ~ e^2

t_transformation_decision.decision_description: Drop binary collisions (C_i[f] = 0), express charge/current as velocity moments, and linearize around stationary distribution to derive wave equations.
t_transformation_decision.computation_on_auxiliary: d^2 rho_1 / dt^2 + omega_0^2 rho_1 = 0 where omega_0^2 = 4 pi N e^2 / m

s1_resulting_conclusion.conclusion_statement: Emergence of organized collective plasma oscillations and wave propagation modes absent in neutral gases.

excluded_alternatives: Treating plasma purely as neutral gas governed by Boltzmann collision integral

notes: Core methodological innovation: do not integrate N-body particle paths; construct continuous 6D distribution f_i, drop short-range collisions, and close self-consistently with collective Maxwell fields.

label: Chebyshev Global Equioscillation & Minimax Synthesis Episode

s0_initial_problem.problem_statement: Continuous function f(x) or mechanism linkage motion on a finite compact interval [a-h, a+h].

q_deficiency.why_direct_solution_fails: Local Taylor series expansion matches derivatives at a single point x_0, causing error to blow up rapidly at interval endpoints; mechanism synthesis requires uniform error bound across entire motion cycle.

a_admissibility.admissibility_class: Polynomials U_n(x) of fixed maximum degree n.

x_auxiliary_construction.auxiliary_object_name: Uniform Error Envelope L and Alternation Polynomial Condition
x_auxiliary_construction.auxiliary_representation_space: Equioscillation algebraic manifold on n+2 points
x_auxiliary_construction.space_change: Infinite-dimensional function space C[a,b] -> Finite-dimensional equioscillating root manifold

c_constraints_invariants.admissibility_bounds: Degree deg(U) <= n; x in [a-h, a+h]

t_transformation_decision.decision_description: Enforce equal-magnitude error condition (f(x) - U(x))^2 - L^2 = 0 across interval endpoints and interior stationary points.
t_transformation_decision.computation_on_auxiliary: (x - a + h)(x - a - h) d(f - U)/dx = 0; ||f - U_n||_inf = min_U max_x |f(x) - U(x)|

s1_resulting_conclusion.conclusion_statement: Unique minimax polynomial approximant U_n^*(x) minimizing supremum norm error uniformly across whole interval.

what_need_not_be_computed: Higher-order local Taylor series derivatives f^{(k)}(x_0) at any single point
Pointwise extrapolation beyond the specified compact interval
excluded_alternatives: Local Taylor polynomial expansion around midpoint
L_2 orthogonal projection without uniform L_infinity error bounds

notes: Core methodological innovation: do not match derivatives locally at a point; construct a global equioscillation error envelope with alternating peaks across the entire domain.

label: Leibniz-Bocker Infinitesimal Motion & Streaming Grassmannian Episode

s0_initial_problem.problem_statement: High-dimensional discrete time series observations x(t) in R^N exhibiting uncalibrated spatial drift, noise, and non-stationarity.

q_deficiency.why_direct_solution_fails: Static state coordinates x(t) confound absolute position drift with true structural dynamics; continuous time derivatives dx/dt are ill-conditioned and amplify discrete sensor noise.

a_admissibility.permissible_domain: Bounded increment magnitudes ||phi(t)|| <= M and uniform spectral gap.
a_admissibility.admissibility_class: Local stationarity and ergodicity of increment field.

x_auxiliary_construction.auxiliary_object_name: Infinitesimal Motion Increment phi(t) and Grassmannian Subspace Frame W_t
x_auxiliary_construction.auxiliary_representation_space: Grassmann manifold Gr(k, N) of k-dimensional subspaces
x_auxiliary_construction.space_change: Static position R^N -> Infinitesimal tendency vector phi(t) -> Subspace projector P_t on Gr(k, N)

invariants: Orthonormality of tracking frame W_t^T W_t = I_k
Curvature non-negativity and horizontal lift gauge

t_transformation_decision.decision_description: Decompose motion into dominant Grassmannian coordinates and orthogonal novelty; update tracking frame online via streaming Oja update with O(Nk^2) complexity.
t_transformation_decision.computation_on_auxiliary: W_{t+1}* = W_t + eta_t phi(t) (phi(t)^T W_t); P_{t+1} = W_{t+1} W_{t+1}^T

s1_resulting_conclusion.conclusion_statement: Gauge-invariant trajectory tracking on Gr(k, N) providing real-time displacement speed diagnostics Omega_k and Omega_tilde_k.

what_need_not_be_computed: Dense N x N outer product covariance matrix in physical memory
excluded_alternatives: Full batch principal component analysis over entire historical window

notes: Core methodological innovation: replace static position with discrete infinitesimal motion; track evolving eigenspaces on the Grassmann manifold via O(Nk^2) streaming updates rather than computing dense covariance.
